test.create_query: CREATE TABLE replacing_updated (id UInt64, ver UInt32, a Float64, b Int64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''
CREATE TABLE replacing_updated_key2 (k UInt8, id UInt64, ver UInt32, a Float64, b Int64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY (k, id) SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = ''

CREATE TABLE replacing_updated_merge (id UInt64, ver UInt32, a Float64, b Int64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY id SETTINGS auto_statistics_types = '', old_parts_lifetime = 10, max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO replacing_updated SELECT intHash64(number), 0, (number % 997) / 7.0, toInt64(number % 100003) FROM numbers(8000000)
INSERT INTO replacing_updated_key2 SELECT intHash64(number) % 16, intHash64(number), 0, (number % 997) / 7.0, toInt64(number % 100003) FROM numbers(8000000)
ALTER TABLE replacing_updated MODIFY SETTING max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1
ALTER TABLE replacing_updated_key2 MODIFY SETTING max_bytes_to_merge_at_max_space_in_pool = 1, max_bytes_to_merge_at_min_space_in_pool = 1

INSERT INTO replacing_updated SELECT intHash64(cityHash64(number % 20000, intDiv(number, 20000)) % 8000000), intDiv(number, 20000) + 1, (number % 991) / 3.0, toInt64(number % 7919) FROM numbers(200000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 20000, max_insert_block_size = 20000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 20000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO replacing_updated_key2 SELECT h % 16, h, intDiv(number, 20000) + 1, (number % 991) / 3.0, toInt64(number % 7919) FROM (SELECT number, intHash64(cityHash64(number % 20000, intDiv(number, 20000)) % 8000000) AS h FROM numbers(200000)) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 20000, max_insert_block_size = 20000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 20000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
SELECT throwIf(count() != 11 OR min(level) = 0) FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'replacing_updated' AND active
SELECT throwIf(count() != 11 OR min(level) = 0) FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'replacing_updated_key2' AND active
ALTER TABLE replacing_updated_merge ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM replacing_updated
OPTIMIZE TABLE replacing_updated_merge FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1
SELECT throwIf(count() != 1) FROM system.parts WHERE database = currentDatabase() AND table = 'replacing_updated_merge' AND active
SELECT throwIf((SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM replacing_updated_merge) != (SELECT (count(), sum(cityHash64(*))) FROM replacing_updated FINAL))
test.query: SELECT id, ver, a, b FROM replacing_updated FINAL FORMAT Null
SELECT id, ver, a, b FROM replacing_updated FINAL FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_vertical_final = 0
SELECT k, id, ver, a, b FROM replacing_updated_key2 FINAL FORMAT Null

${CLICKHOUSE_CLIENT} --query "TRUNCATE TABLE replacing_updated_merge; ALTER TABLE replacing_updated_merge ATTACH PARTITION ALL FROM replacing_updated; OPTIMIZE TABLE replacing_updated_merge FINAL SETTINGS optimize_throw_if_noop = 1"
test.drop_query: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS replacing_updated, replacing_updated_key2, replacing_updated_merge SYNC
